shots.content: Inside a living room, a sofa and armchairs surround a low coffee table between a bookcase and the doorway. A man in a yellow shirt is in the bookcase-side sofa seat and recounts the sequence of partners from the evening ball. A woman in a purple shirt is in the doorway-side sofa seat. A woman in a red shirt is in the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway side, looking across the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a purple shirt leaves the doorway-side sofa seat and exits the venue. A man in a yellow shirt asks to finish the report of the dance.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two adjacent sofa seats.

shots.content: A man in a yellow shirt praises the final dance of the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the bookcase side, looking across the coffee table toward the doorway, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.
